decisions.reason: The dedicated page and centrality to mental health services reflect high public commitment, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely.
The carpentry workshop has its own page and builds on production know-how, so visible commitment and sunk costs support persistence.
Being shown on the home page signals strong public commitment and the counseling service is central to eldercare, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The retail shop leverages the sheltered workshop but has only a website mention, so commitment is weaker and the chance of dropping is moderate, though persistence is still likely.

The meal delivery service is close to the established offer but only mentioned on the website and launched recently, giving it lower sunk costs and public commitment, so the probability of withdrawal is higher.
